title_sq: Tek Bulevardi i Ri Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Perfekte !
description_sq: Tek Bulevardi i Ri Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Perfekte !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 106.93m2 ndodhet ne katin e 5-te banim te nje Rezidence te re banimi ne faze karabina. Apartamenti organizohet ne ambientin e ndenjes me siperfaqe te bollshme se bashku me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualet, dhome gjumi femijesh dhe tualeti i dites. title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 with perfect floor plan for sale at New Boulevard!
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 with perfect floor plan for sale at New Boulevard!! The apartment with a total area of ​​106.93m2 is located on the 5th residential floor of a new residential residence in the carbine phase. The apartment is organized in a spacious living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, a matrimonial bedroom with a toilet, a children's bedroom and a day toilet. The apartment has a South-West orientation, which allows natural lighting throughout the day. The New Boulevard area is considered one of the most promising areas in terms of infrastructure development, services and access to the central areas of Tirana, making it enviable both for investment in the future and for housing.
